label: Period Delay
protocol: EDM-PD-01 v2.4 — Norethisterone for Period Delay

ruleGuide.name: Pregnancy, breastfeeding & recent birth
ruleGuide.summary: SmPC absolute — pregnancy, breastfeeding, or <6 weeks postpartum.

ruleGuide.name: Norethisterone allergy
ruleGuide.summary: SmPC absolute — anaphylaxis, angioedema or serious reaction to norethisterone.

ruleGuide.name: Blood clots / thrombophilia
ruleGuide.summary: SmPC absolute — DVT, PE, retinal thrombosis, thrombophilia, antiphospholipid syndrome.

ruleGuide.name: Arterial disease
ruleGuide.summary: SmPC absolute — MI, angina, stroke, TIA or other arterial thrombosis.

ruleGuide.name: Liver disease & pregnancy liver reactions
ruleGuide.summary: SmPC absolute — severe liver disease, tumours, jaundice; obstetric cholestasis / pemphigoid gestationis history.

ruleGuide.name: Hormone-sensitive cancer
ruleGuide.summary: SmPC absolute — breast/genital tract cancer, breast lump, nipple discharge, active anticancer treatment.

ruleGuide.name: Abnormal bleeding
ruleGuide.summary: SmPC absolute — undiagnosed irregular bleeding or untreated endometrial hyperplasia.

ruleGuide.name: Migraine with aura
ruleGuide.summary: Absolute — migraine with aura (flashing lights, one-sided numbness).

ruleGuide.name: Other contraindications
ruleGuide.summary: Service exclusions — IBD, SLE, sickle cell, RA, porphyria, gallstones, HF, renal impairment, hypertension, dyslipidaemia, diabetes, epilepsy, surgery/immobilisation.

ruleGuide.name: Antiepileptic medicines
ruleGuide.summary: Service exclusion — enzyme-inducing and interacting AEDs (Section 8 & Step 2E).

ruleGuide.name: Enzyme inducers
ruleGuide.summary: Service exclusion — rifampicin, efavirenz, St John's Wort, etc.

ruleGuide.name: Cancer treatments
ruleGuide.summary: Service exclusion — chemotherapy, immunotherapy, hormone therapy (tamoxifen, GnRH agonists).

ruleGuide.name: Hormonal contraception
ruleGuide.summary: Service exclusion — COC, POP, implant, injection, patch, ring, hormonal IUS, ellaOne.

ruleGuide.name: HIV & HCV treatments
ruleGuide.summary: Service exclusion — antiretrovirals and hepatitis C combinations.

ruleGuide.name: Diabetes, BP & cholesterol meds
ruleGuide.summary: Consultation screen (Step 2E) — diabetes, statin and antihypertensive medicines on SCR.
